errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the values are expressed in 'millions (billions)'. The legend clearly states 'Купувачи (в млрд.)', which translates to 'Buyers (in billions)'. The 'millions' part is a hallucination and creates ambiguity.
The description identifies the blue data series as a 'line', but it is clearly an area chart, with the area under the top boundary filled in blue.
The word 'устойчива' (sustainable) is an interpretation of the quality of the growth trend, not a direct visual observation from the chart data. The prompt specifically forbids interpretation.
